verdict.rationale: Superpowers is a library of markdown skill files installed into local coding-agent harnesses, with no hosted backend that stores user data, so choosing a storage region or residency is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence shows only local, plan-scoped workspace directories (e.g. `.superpowers/sdd/`) inside the user's project, which is not a region or residency choice and does not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
